title: This phone runs from its second system copy
body: This phone is running from its second system copy (slot B). Omarchy Mobile is written there, and Android must stay on the first copy (slot A) as your way back.
If Omarchy Mobile is already on this phone and you are installing it again, start the installer again and say that this is a reinstall.
If the phone runs Android (it moves to slot B after an Android system update), Android has to be put on slot A first. The install guide says how.
footer: The installer only asked the phone what it is. It has written nothing to it.
Starting the installer again as things are will stop here again.
